title: Action run
description: Shared shapes for startAction and continueAction: checkpoint policy, the action log, paused and finished actions. A paused action is plain data, so the app can continue it later, elsewhere.

definingAction.description: The qualified ID of the action whose step this is (`mothership-1e:panic-check`); for an action defined inline on an item, the qualified item ID plus `#<action id>`. Apps build the step's text keys from it.

rollSummary.description: A roll step's summary: what the roll is rolled against, worked out when the roll is built, before any face is rolled, in the step's band context without `roll`. Output only: replay never reads it.

bandSet.description: The qualified ID of the step's band set; absent when the step has none (then so are `value` and `bands`).

value.description: A band set with a `value`: that formula with every subexpression that doesn't read `roll` resolved to a literal, as canonical formula text.

bands.description: The bands that can still hold, in the set's order: each band whose resolved condition isn't `false`, up to and including the first whose resolved condition is `true`.

success.description: The band is its set's success threshold (`success: true`): what the roll needs.

when.description: The band's condition with every maximal subexpression that doesn't read `roll` evaluated and printed back as a literal, literal guards folded, as canonical formula text. A subexpression that fails to evaluate, or gives a map, is left as written.

tests.description: When the resolved condition is `true`, `[]`; when it is a conjunction (`&&`) of comparisons each between a roll path (`roll.total`, `roll.value`, `roll.unbounded`, `roll.kept[<int>]`) and a number literal, those comparisons in order, the roll path on the left. Absent otherwise: the band has its text only.

flags.description: The running action's flags at the step (the action `action` names), as data, as `outcome.data` reports values (a dice value as dice notation). `{}` when there are none.

rollTest.description: One comparison of a roll path with a number. Apps word it with the pack's `bands.<set>.<band>.condition` text, else the spec's `compare.<code>` text (packages/spec/i18n).

of.description: The roll path, as formula text: `roll.total`, `roll.value`, `roll.unbounded` or `roll.kept[<int>]`.

participant.description: The participant a handoff is for: its role and its view's `id`.

outcome.description: How an action finished: its `result` and `data`.

amounts.description: Allocation amounts by qualified field ID: for a budget step the amount added, for a values step the value given.

answer.description: An answer to one pause, as continueAction takes it and as startAction's `answers` lists them: `faces` for a dice pause, `option` for a choice, `amounts` for an allocation, `outcome` for a handoff.

oneOf.description: An allocation's answer: amounts by field ID. A negative amount, a field not offered, an amount over its limit, a total cost that breaks the budget, or values not each used exactly once, is `answer-mismatch`.
A handoff's answer: the outcome of the used action the app ran on the participant's own character, as that run finished. A `result` the used action doesn't declare is `answer-mismatch`.

policy.description: When the engine continues by itself and when it pauses. Rules are checked in order; the first matching rule decides; unmatched checkpoints use the defaults.

tags.description: Matches a roll step, a choice step or an allocation step carrying any of these tags, or a tag below one.

logEntry.description: One die face set, choice, allocation or handoff answer, however supplied. Replaying an action from its log always gives the same result.

step.description: Step path, e.g. `attack`, `hit/damage`, or `saves[1]` for the second participant of an `each` step.

of.description: A roll step with `of`: the full path of the earlier roll it classified again (`check/roll`). It rolled nothing, so the entry has no `faces`; `items` and `total` are that roll's, `band` its own.

faces.description: The faces the step used. A roll step with no dice items is not a checkpoint and has none.

draw.description: Dice entries of a random draw on a choice or allocate step: what the face picked among. Its one face is `faces[0]`.

option.description: The picked option ID; `#done` when a repeated choice step was ended early.

index.description: Choice steps with `repeat`: which pick of the step this is, from 0. Each pick is its own entry with the same `step`.

choice.description: Choice steps over pending choices: the path of the choice the pick answered. On replay, a recorded pick whose choice is no longer the one asked is `answer-mismatch`.

amounts.description: Allocation steps: the amounts, as answered or recommended.

participant.description: Handoffs: the participant who ran the used action.

outcome.description: Handoffs: the outcome the app answered with.

bandSet.description: Roll steps with a band: the qualified ID of the band set the step classified by, so an app names the band `bands.<set>.<band>.name` in the set's pack.

bandValue.description: Roll steps classified by a band set with a `value`: that value, as data (orc-2e's degree of success as a rank).

summary.description: Roll steps, a dice-less roll step's entry included: the roll's summary, worked out before the roll, so it matches what a pause for it showed.

bounds.description: Roll steps: each `atLeast` or `atMost` roll effect that changed the total, in the order applied (the highest `atLeast`, then the lowest `atMost`). `total` is the bounded total; `items` and `faces` are unchanged.

rolls.description: Roll steps made more than once (advantage or disadvantage `of: roll`): every roll, in roll order, with its total before bounds; `kept` marks the one kept, whose items are `items`. On a roll's parts, the items not rolled again are the same in every roll. `faces` lists every die rolled once each. Absent for a roll made once.

tallies.description: Roll steps: each roll tally with a non-zero value, with what contributed to it.

need.description: What a paused action is waiting for.

kind.description: `dice`, `choice`, `allocate` (the app answers with `amounts`), or `handoff`: the app runs `run` on `participant`'s own character and answers with its outcome.

dice.description: The dice to roll, in order; the app answers with one face per die.

draw.description: A dice pause for a random draw on a choice or allocate step: one die, as many sides as `among` has entries; the face picks among them.

items.description: The itemized roll so far, for display while waiting.

repeat.description: Dice steps made more than once (advantage or disadvantage `of: roll`): `times` rolls of `items`, whose dice `dice` lists roll after roll, and the total kept: `high` or `low`. With `items` (on a roll's parts), only those items, by index in `items`, are rolled again: `dice` lists every die once, then those items' dice for each later roll. Absent for a roll made once.

items.description: The items rolled again, by index in `items`; the others are rolled once and count in every roll. Absent when the whole roll is made again.

summary.description: Dice steps: the summary of the roll the pause is for; a pause for more dice mid-roll carries the same one. To preview a roll, an app starts the action with `dice: 'pause'`, reads this and drops the result.

options.description: The offered option IDs, in order: written option IDs, qualified content IDs or instance IDs. A repeated step that has its `min` picks offers the reserved `#done` last.

recommended.description: The recommended option, if any; never `#done`.

content.description: Choice steps over values, and their random draws: the qualified ID of the content the action runs for (its `item`: the copy's item, the picked or granted content, an applied entry's source); absent for an action run without content. The app names each value `<content>.options.<value>.name` when the content's pack has it, else `<actionKey>.options.<value>.name`, else as it names a plain value.

choice.description: Choice steps over pending choices: the choice being asked, also on a random draw's dice pause there. The app names it with the choice's own text (`<owner>.choices.<id>.prompt`) and its options as it names `listOptions` results.

owner.description: The key root of the choice's owner, qualified: the content ID (`5e-srd-5.1:classes.fighter`), `<pack>:rules` for a rules-level choice, and for a choice nested in an inline option the owner's root plus `.choices.<choice>.options.<option>`.

id.description: The choice's ID: for a slot of a slotted choice, the slot's own (`class-feat-2`).

slot.description: A slot of a slotted choice: the declared choice ID, whose prompt names it, and the slot's number, the prompt's `{slot}`.

min.description: The choice's evaluated `min` picks, as `listOptions` gives it.

max.description: The choice's evaluated `max` picks, as `listOptions` gives it; absent when unbounded.

picked.description: How many picks the choice has so far, on the proposed sheet, this step's earlier picks included. An app shows "pick 2 of 6" from `picked`, `min` and `max`.

allocate.description: Allocation steps: what may be allocated. The app answers with `amounts`, a map of field ID to amount (fields left out get nothing).

fields.description: The offered fields in order: the qualified ID, the computed value before the step, the input value before the step and, for a budget step, the most the field can take (the smaller of its `max` less its input value and the step's `limit`) and each amount's cost.

value.description: The field's computed value before the step: its input value with every effect applied.

input.description: The field's input value before the step (saved, else its default), before effects. The step's amounts add to it; `value` less `input` is what effects add.

costs.description: Budget steps: `costs[n]` is what giving the field `n` costs, from 0 (always 0) to its `limit`, or to the budget when it has none, and to 100 at most; it stops before an amount whose cost fails to evaluate. The amounts' total cost is the sum of `costs[amount]`. An amount past the array may still be answered; the engine checks it.

budget.description: Budget steps: the total to spend. Nothing is spent before the answer: the step is one checkpoint.

values.description: Values steps: the values to hand out, one field each, every value used once.

recommended.description: The recommended amounts, when the step has a usable recommendation.

run.description: Handoffs: the action to run on the participant, `action` the qualified ID of the step's `use`, `params` its evaluated parameters and `participants` (when the step passes any) the used action's roles, each a list of IDs: participants of the running action, or the running character's own `id`. The app passes their views to the run.

to.description: `self`, `target`, a role of the action, or `{ link }` with the qualified slot ID.

character.description: The ID of the character the change is for: for `to: { link }`, the character filling that slot (its view's `id`), absent when the slot is empty; for a role (`target`, `helper`), the participant's view `id`, absent when no participant was given. The slot is qualified (`{ link: fitd-scoundrel:crew }`).

step.description: The path of the `changes` step that proposed it (`deal`, `panic/stress`); a split adjust's changes share it.

state.description: Everything needed to continue: the action, character, inputs (link views and participants included, so continueAction takes none) and position, handoff outcomes included. Plain data; engine-defined beyond being JSON. PROVISIONAL.

draw.description: A random draw: the die picks `among[face - 1]`, the option IDs a choice step offers (its source's, in order) or the field IDs an allocate step may give the next value or unit to, by qualified ID in field order.
